name: Labraid Luathlám ar Claideb
text: Labraid Luathlám ar Claideb, the swift sword-hand, rules over Mag Mell, the Plain of Delight. When he needs help he sends his beautiful wife Li Ban to seek Cúchulainn in the tale the Wasting Sickness of Cúchulainn.

key_results: Name the tale in which he seeks help.
